\vspace{4pt}
\raggedright\footnotesize
\textit{Notes:} Standard errors in parentheses. Panel A reports the demand elasticity $\phi_d$ from the aggregate equation; Panel B the supply elasticity $\phi_s$ from the disaggregated equation with the equal-weights aggregator $H = e_N/N$. OLS is endogenous: common shocks bias it toward zero, and sign reversal is possible. GIV (Gabaix and Koijen, 2024): idiosyncratic supply shocks to large producers instrument for price. The two GIV rows share a single point estimate and differ only in the standard error. The naive SE treats the estimated factor structure, and hence the instrument, as known. The corrected SE, developed in this paper, accounts for estimating the factor structure used to construct the instrument. Factors and the instrument are built from the demeaned panel; the controls $X$ enter only at the second stage. All standard errors are HAC (Newey--West, Bartlett kernel, bandwidth $\lfloor 1.3\sqrt{T}\rfloor$). Control sets differ by commodity. Year-on-year midpoint growth transformation throughout.
